guideline: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) for Kerala Farmers
principlesEn: Regular field monitoring once per week
Biological control using Trichoderma, Pseudomonas fluorescens, and Beauveria bassiana
Mechanical traps: Yellow sticky traps for whiteflies, Pheromone traps for fruit flies
Chemical pesticides as last resort adhering strictly to safety waiting periods
